_readme: P6.1's synthetic ScenarioDecision — the second of the two committed generator inputs. Every field of §7's ScenarioDecision TypedDict carries a literal value, so P6.2's `emit_template_config` run is reproducible and reviewable rather than driven by an ad-hoc dict typed into a shell command. `probed_ids` are deliberately DISJOINT from src/data/cleared-set.json's ids: run_prep.py passes the winner's probed_ids to run_curation as exclude_ids, so the trial's records and the curated cleared set are different samples by construction (§7). `emit_template_config` itself reads only `outcome` and `winner`; the rest is here because the plan pins it and because a half-specified fixture is a TBD wearing an adjective. NOTE: the plan (P6.1) homes this file at prep/tests/fixtures/synthetic_scenario_decision.json; it lives here instead because the P6.2/P6.3 task was scoped read-only over prep/ (a concurrent agent owns that tree). Nothing in prep/ references it — its only consumer is P6.2's generator invocation.
